flags.title: Four requirement registers hold contradictory statuses
flags.detail: research/nfl-requirements.json (16 rows), research/requirements.json (44 rows), research/nfl-readiness.json (81 rows) and research/nfl-decision-readiness.json (70 rows) each carry their own statuses. Example: DR-61 is 'Open' in the 70-row ledger while two desks render a what-changed diff. This desk does not edit the 70-row ledger; it publishes the reconciled statuses beside it.
flags.decision: Owner to choose the one register that the landing page renders (see suggestion S1).

flags.title: Week 10 injury captures disagree on row counts and on Cincinnati
flags.detail: Availability desk CSV: 326 rows, 28 clubs, Cincinnati 8, Seattle 15. Assurance desk CSV: 276 rows, 26 clubs, Cincinnati 4, Seattle 15, no rows for Baltimore or the Chargers. Dated read 2026-11-17: 347 rendered rows. Research extract: 20 rows. The requirement text's 254 and 279 targets appear in no committed capture. Four clubs (CHI, DEN, PHI, TB) are absent from the availability CSV and are exactly the Week 10 bye clubs in the official schedule capture.
flags.decision: A full, timestamped official recount is needed before any Week 10 injury count is quoted as the league total (see question Q4).

flags.title: NFL.com terms §1.3 prohibit systematic retrieval without written consent
flags.detail: Verbatim §1.3 is in the evidence file. A scheduled daily capture of the injury report or depth pages is systematic retrieval to compile a collection. This desk does not build one. Four ledger rows (DR-21, DR-29, DR-54, DR-66) stay Blocked on this gate.
flags.decision: Owner decides whether to request written consent from NFL Legal, license data elsewhere, or drop automated capture (see suggestion S2).

flags.title: NFL.com terms §12 prohibit using the Services to wager on NFL games
flags.detail: Verbatim §12 sentence is in the evidence file: users are prohibited 'from using the Services to gamble or wager on the result of any NFL game'. This project's stated purpose is to originate betting lines. Whether analysis of published facts falls within that sentence is a legal question. The desk makes no legal determination.
flags.decision: Owner to take legal advice before any line is published externally (see question Q2).

flags.title: No official NFL snap-count source has been located
flags.detail: The search on 2026-11-18 returned only third-party sites. Depth-order routes (b) and the snap-count proxy stay Open (DR-11, DR-52, DR-56). This is a search result, not an exhaustive survey of nfl.com.
flags.decision: Owner to decide whether to ask the league for a data arrangement (see suggestion S3).

flags.title: Two Week 1-10 results files (149 and 150 rows)
flags.detail: nfl-results/data/games-2026-w1-10.csv (149 rows) and games-2026-w1-10-complete.csv (150 rows). The only difference is the Chargers 23, Ravens 20 final (LAC@BAL), which the canonical file omits (logged as FG02 on the fresh-reads desk). Both files are committed; the ledger's DR-02 cites the 150-row file.
flags.decision: Owner to choose the canonical file (see suggestion S5).

flags.title: The 'random picks' control is not implemented as written
flags.detail: DR-57 names random picks and favourites as baselines. Only the favourite-side control is published. The random-sign permutation test is a different statistic.

flags.title: Rules page detail beyond the change table is not re-verified
flags.detail: The change table (6-1-3, 6-1-5, 6-1-6, 19-2) was re-read and matches. The element values on rules-2026.html (declaration deadline, surprise-onside answer, restraining lines, setup-zone width) come from the rulebook body, which was not read this session.
flags.decision: Read the rulebook sections 6-1-2 and 6-1-6 in full before the element values are used (see suggestion S7).

flags.title: The reserve list shows a rolling window
flags.detail: Eight rows printed on the 2026-11-17 capture (11/07 to 11/10) are not rendered on the live November page. Older IR moves can be recovered only from dated captures. Jackson and Huntley's absence from both visible windows proves nothing about their earlier IR dates.
flags.decision: Capture the reserve list at read time from now on (requires the consent decision in S2).
